title: Graduation Project — Design of a New GIB Assembly Line Using DMADV
summary: Graduation project focused on designing a proposed in-house Gas-Insulated Busduct (GIB) assembly line using the Lean Six Sigma DMADV methodology.
challenge: Explore how an internal GIB assembly line could address capacity, space, and lead-time constraints.
approach: Applied Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, and Verify; examined facility layout, material flow, capacity, testing needs, and operational risks.
outcome: Proposed project improvements: 64% reduction in lead time, 61% increase in production capacity, and 6% improvement in space utilization. These are graduation-project results, not company-wide verified outcomes.
learned: Engineering improvements must align layout, resources, capacity, quality, and execution constraints.
